description: Emergency Preparedness and Response: Natural Disasters and Severe Weather is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. Learn how to protect yourself and your family from floods, tornadoes, wildfires, and other natural disasters and severe weather. The site is categorized by hazard, and includes health and safety information pertinent for all disasters. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Drought, Extreme Cold, Extreme Heat, Flooding – General, Landslides, Severe Winter Weather, Water Quality, Wildfire. Assets: Critical Facilities, Cultural and Community Services, Economy, People, Property, Water Infrastructure – Stormwater. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
